$comment: Earnings Maps design tokens. Gate 2 (2026-10-17): the owner picked light editorial and the am_michael voice; the other looks are kept as frames in brand/style-frames/.

safe_zone_9x16.$comment: Rule of thumb from the brief; confirm with a private test upload. Critical text stays inside.

type_scale_px.$comment: Minimums from the brief: labels >= 44 px, key numbers >= 72 px at 1080 wide.
type_scale_px.footer_note: Footer lines (source, period, disclaimer) sit at 32 px. They're legally required, not a key number or label; checked for legibility at Gate 2.

money.rule: Billions with one decimal ($94.9B); below $1B use millions with no decimal ($812M). Negative values use U+2212 and parentheses only where the release does.

change.rule: Whole percent with sign; U+2212 minus for declines; one decimal only when |change| < 1%.

margin.rule: Whole percent, one decimal when the change vs last year is under one point.

motion.engine: GSAP 3.14.2 (local file), one paused seekable timeline per composition

color_rules.source: dataviz skill: validate_palette.js --pairs all on each theme's surface (2026-10-17)
color_rules.flows: revenue blue, costs orange, profit aqua-green. Segments are nominal categories, so every segment wears the revenue color, separated by 2px gaps and identified by labels.
color_rules.loss: a loss uses the cost color with a 45° hatch and the word 'loss': no fourth hue clears the colour-blind floors next to blue/orange/aqua.
color_rules.text: values and labels wear ink tokens, never the flow color; accent only on large type (light theme accent is 3.8:1).
color_rules.surfaces: light editorial on cool paper #F4F6F5 (not cream); flow colors validated on it with the dataviz checker
